scenarios.name: node-sse-server-with-state-and-tool
scenarios.rationale: B uses EventEncoder from @ag-ui/encoder with getContentType(), emits every required event type including STATE_SNAPSHOT then STATE_DELTA JSON Patch, streams text word by word, and takes threadId/runId from the input; A hand-rolls SSE with no @ag-ui/encoder (a core rubric item) but does otherwise cover the event types, so it earns only partial credit.

scenarios.name: langgraph-agent-to-copilotkit-chat
scenarios.rationale: B matches the rubric: it registers HttpAgent({url}) in a CopilotRuntime agents map, exposes it with createCopilotRuntimeHandler, and renders CopilotKit with runtimeUrl and a CopilotChat with a matching agentId, all from the v2 paths, without rewriting the agent. A uses the older v1 API (copilotruntime NextJS endpoint, LangGraphHttpAgent, react-ui, the `agent` prop), and it tells the user to add a Python AG-UI adapter, which means changing the agent.

scenarios.name: fix-run-failing-on-unclosed-message
scenarios.rationale: B covers all the rubric points: it says the unclosed message needs TEXT_MESSAGE_END before RUN_FINISHED, that unknown properties are stripped with metadata as the place for extra data, that optional fields must be absent not null, and it mentions RUN_ERROR. A gets the TEXT_MESSAGE_END fix and the null handling, but wrongly suggests unknown keys are tolerated and never mentions RUN_ERROR.
